name: Divider
summary: A break between two parts of one flow. The space either side is its parent's gap (a Stack's), never its own. Not between page sections (they part by space, alignment and type) and not inside a list (its items part themselves).
a11y: An `hr`: the separator role, announced as a break and nothing else; the dots are drawn, not text. In forced colours the rule and the dots take the text colour.

props.name: variant
props.description: `rule` (default): a hairline across, the quiet line between two parts. `dinkus`: three small dots at the centre in the accent, a magazine's break between two whole stories (two albums one after another).
